answer_1.quote: Data-to-text generation aims to produce human‑understandable text from semi‑structured data such as tables, concepts, etc.
answer_1.outputs: Generated natural‑language sentences describing the input records

answer_2.quote: We use three popular metrics‑BLEU, ROUGE and METEOR ... We also use a recent data‑to‑text generation evaluation metric, PARENT, which considers both input data and reference texts.

answer_4.quote: In human‑based evaluation for annotations purpose, we select four university graduate students ... Every instance is annotated by at least three human annotators. For adequacy and readability, every annotator is asked to rate each text on a scale of 1 to 5, where 5 is the best.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated text on adequacy (correctness) and readability (fluency) using a 1‑to‑5 Likert scale.
